name: grav-plugin-gis
description: Front-end dependencies of the GIS plugin, copied into lib/ by `npm run leaflet`

scripts.leaflet: rm -rf lib/leaflet && mkdir -p lib/leaflet/images && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js.map node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css node_modules/leaflet/LICENSE lib/leaflet/ && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/images/* lib/leaflet/images/
